स्फुट् स्फुट् (connected with rts. स्फुर्,
स्फुल्), cl. 6. P. स्फुटति, cl. 1. P. A.
स्फोटति, -ते, पुस्फोट, पुस्फुटे, अस्फुटत्, अस्-
फुटीत्, अस्फोटीत्, स्फुटितुम् (cl. 1. स्फोटितुम्), to
burst or become suddenly rent asunder, burst open,
split open, part asunder, break forth, expand; to
blossom, blow (generally A.); to burst into view, be-
[]
come manifested or made public, to disperse, run
away; cl. 10. P. स्फुटयति, to burst, crack, break
open; to burst into view: Pass. स्फुट्यते, Aor.
अस्फोटि: Caus. स्फोटयति, to burst or rend sud-
denly, break, split, cleave, tear open, divide; to
disclose, make clear; to hurt, destroy, kill; to
winnow.

स्फुट्ट् स्फुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. स्फुट्टयति, &c.,
to despise, disrespect.

स्फुट, अस्, आ, अम्, burst, split open, broken,
rent, torn, opened, expanded; open, blossomed,
blown; clearly displayed, clear; plain, distinct, mani-
fest, evident; well known or understood; bright;
white; loud; spread, diffused; (in astronomy) ap-
parent, true; corrected; (आ), f. the expanded hood
of a serpent; (अम्), ind. distinctly, manifestly, evi-
dently, certainly.
—स्फुट-ता, f. openness, mani-
festation; perspicuity; blossoming.
—स्फुट-तार,
अस्, आ, अम्, having stars clearly seen, bright with
stars.
—स्फुट-पौरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
displayed valour or energy.
—स्फुट-फल, अम्,
n. (in geometry) clear or precise result (of any
calculation); distinct or precise area (of a triangle
&c.).
—स्फुट-बन्धनी, f. a kind of plant, heart-
pea (= पारावत-पदी).
—स्फुट-वल्कली, f. the
plant heart-pea.
—स्फुट-सार, अस्, m. (probably)
the true latitude of a star or planet.
—स्फुट-सूर्य-
गति, इस्, f. apparent or true motion of the sun.
—स्फुटार्थ (˚ट-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a clear
meaning, intelligible, obvious, significant.
—स्फुटी-
करण, अम्, n. the act of displaying clearly, making
distinct; making true or correct, correction.

स्फुटत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, bursting open, part-
ing or bursting asunder, splitting in two; blowing,
blossoming; becoming manifest or clear; evolving.

स्फुटन, अम्, n. the act of breaking or rending
suddenly, bursting, tearing open, disruption, open-
ing, expanding, blossoming.

स्फुटनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken open or
split.

स्फुटि, इस्, or स्फुटी, f. cracking or chapping of
the skin of the feet, sores or swelling of the feet;
the fruit of the Karkaṭī or a sort of melon, Cucumis
Momordica.

स्फुटिका, f. (probably) a small bit broken off,
little bit or piece.

स्फुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, burst, broken open, split,
cracked; budded, blown, expanded (as a flower);
made clear, manifested, spread out; torn, destroyed;
laughed at (= परि-हसित; cf. rt. स्फुण्ट्).
—स्फु-
टित-चरण, अस्, आ, अम्, having wide feet, splay-
footed.

स्फुड् स्फुड्, cl. 6. P. स्फुडति, &c., to
cover.

स्फुण्ट् स्फुण्ट्, cl. 1. P. स्फुण्टति, &c.,
to open, expand, &c. (= rt. स्फुट्);
cl. 10. P. स्फुण्टयति, &c., to jest, joke, laugh at
(= rt. स्फण्ड्).

स्फुण्ड् स्फुण्ड्, cl. 1. A. स्फुण्डते, &c.,
to open, expand, &c. (= rt. स्फुट्); cl.
10. P. स्फुण्डयति, &c., to jest, &c. (= rt.
स्फण्ड्).

स्फुत् स्फुत्, an imitative sound; [cf. फुत्.]
—स्फुत्-कर, अस्, m. ‘making a blowing or
crackling sound,’ fire.
—स्फुत्-कार, अस्, m. making
the noise स्फुत्, crackling, burning.

स्फुर् स्फुर् (= rt. स्फर्, which appears
in the Caus. and is probably the older
form, see स्फर्; the rt. स्फुर् is evidently con-
nected with rts. स्फुट्, स्फुल्), cl. 6. P. स्फुरति,
पुस्फोर, स्फुरिष्यति, अस्फुरीत्, Prec. स्फूर्-
यात्, स्फुरितुम्, to tremble, palpitate, throb, vibrate,
thrill, quiver, twitch, become agitated, struggle; to
start, dart, spring, bound; to spring back, rebound;
to spring up, shoot out, break forth, burst out plainly
or visibly, start into view, be evident or manifest,
appear clearly, become displayed or expanded; to
flash, scintillate, twinkle, sparkle, shine, gleam,
glitter; to flash on the mind, rush into the memory;
to go tremulously; to bruise, destroy, (Sāy. स्फुरत्
= स्फुरिष्यति = वाधिष्यति, Ṛg-veda

स्फुर, अस्, m. trembling, throbbing; swelling;
coruscating; a shield.

स्फुरण, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of trembling,
throbbing, pulsation, vibration; quivering or throb-
bing of parts of the body (e. g. quivering of the
lips, twitching of the eyes, &c., as indicating good
or bad luck); springing or breaking forth, starting
into view, expansion; flashing, coruscation, scintilla-
tion, twinkling, glittering; flashing on the mind.

स्फुरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, trembling, shaking,
quivering, throbbing; starting, darting; springing
up, breaking forth, bursting out plainly or visibly,
becoming clear or manifest; flashing, glittering;
flashing vividly on the mind; swelling, expanding
[cf. स्फुटत्]; going, moving; going tremulously.
—स्फुरद्-अधरोष्ठ (˚र-ओष्˚) or स्फुरद्-
ओष्ठ, अस्, ई, अम्, having quivering lips, (स्फुरद्-
अधरोष्ठम्, ind. with quivering or pouting lips.)
—स्फुरद्-उल्का, f. a shooting meteor, aerolite.
—स्फुरदुल्काकृति (˚का-आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having
the form of a shooting meteor.

स्फुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, heaving, throb-
bing, thrilling, palpitating; shaken, agitated; flash-
ing, glittering, gleaming, playing, unsteady; swelled,
swollen; (अम्), n. a throb, throbbing, tremor,
quivering or twitching of the eyelids, &c., agitation
or emotion of mind.
—स्फुरित-शतह्रद, अस्, आ,
अम्, having flashing lightning (said of a cloud).
—स्फुरितोत्तराधर (˚त-उत्˚, ˚र-अध्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having trembling upper and under lips.

स्फूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to some) throbbed,
throbbing; suddenly risen into remembrance.

स्फूर्ति, इस्, f. throb, palpitation, tremor, trem-
bling, shaking, vibration; spring, bound, start;
breaking forth visibly, becoming evident or apparent,
manifestation, expansion; flashing on the mind or
memory.
—स्फूर्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, throbbing,
[]
thrilling (with joy or excitement), tremulous, agi-
tated; tender-hearted; (आन्), m. a follower or wor-
shipper of Śiva (= पाशुपत).

स्फुर्छ् स्फुर्छ् (also written स्वुर्छ्), cl.
1. P. स्फूर्छति, पुस्फूर्छ, स्फूर्-
छितुम्, to spread, extend; to forget.
स्फूर्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, spread; forgotten.
1. स्फूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, = स्फूर्छित above.

2. स्फूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to some) thun-
dered.

स्फुर्ज् स्फुर्ज् (probably connected with
rt. स्फुर्), cl. 1. P. स्फूर्जति, पु-
स्फूर्ज, स्फूर्जितुम्, to thunder, make a sound
like a thunder-clap, crash, explode: Pass. स्फूर्ज्-
यते: Caus. स्फूर्जयति: Desid. पुस्फूर्जिषति:
Intens. पोस्फूर्ज्यते, पोस्फूर्क्ति; [cf. Lat. spargo;
Angl. Sax. sprecan, sprœncan, sprengan, sprin-
can, springan.]
स्फुर्जक = स्फूर्जक below.

स्फूर्जक, अस्, m. a sort of ebony tree, Diospyros
Glutinosa (= तिन्दुक).
स्फुर्जथु = स्फूर्जथु below.
स्फूर्जथु, उस्, m. a clap of thunder, explosion.

स्फूर्ज, अस्, m. the crashing sound of a thunder-
clap, thunder; Indra's thunderbolt; sudden burst,
(नर्म-स्फूर्ज, sudden burst of love; in dramatic
action defined to mean सुखारम्भो भयान्तो
नव-सङ्गमः, first union of lovers characterized
by joy in the beginning and some cause of fear in
the end.)
—स्फूर्जा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, thundering.

स्फूर्जन, अम्, n. the act of thundering; an
explosion, crash.

स्फूर्जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. overwhelming,
crushing, (Sāy. = निष्पिषत्.)

स्फूर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, thundered; [cf. वि-स्फूर्-
जित.]

स्फुल् स्फुल् (connected with rts. स्फुर्,
स्फुट्, स्फल्), cl. 6. P. स्फुलति, पु-
स्फोल, Aor. अस्फुलीत्, स्फुलितुम्, to tremble,
throb, vibrate; to dart forth, appear; to collect; to
slay, kill, (enumerated among the वध-कर्माणः
in Naigh.
II. 19
स्फुल, अम्, n. a tent (= वस्त्र-वेश्मन्).

स्फुलन, अम्, n. trembling, throbbing, vibration,
palpitation.

स्फुलिङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. (perhaps to be
connected with स्फुत्, p. 1152), a spark of fire.

स्फुलिङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having sparks of fire,
sparkling; (इनी), f., N. of one of the seven tongues
of Agni or fire.
